title: Understanding the Mode
text: The mode of a dataset is the value that appears most frequently. Think about how this might affect the Mean Squared Error (MSE) when used as a constant prediction.

hintAnswer: It is the most frequently occurring value in the dataset.
title: Exploring MSE Minimization
text: Which of the following is true about the mode of a dataset?
choices: It is the most frequently occurring value in the dataset.
It is the average of the dataset.
It is the middle value of the dataset.

title: Connecting Mode and MSE
text: Consider how using the mode as a constant prediction might affect the sum of squared differences between the predicted and actual values. Would it minimize the MSE?
